source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U06: Determine authority extent,agent type,notice of restrictions and delegation limits

payload.title: Authority is a scope question,not a confidence rating
payload.core_explanation_md:
A special agent has a defined task;general authority concerns the relevant business or employment;the universal description still does not authorise unlawful acts. Examine the actual authority and the third-party position rather than assuming a trusted representative can bind the principal on every matter. Personal or official acts can also have restrictions on representation.

Changes to authority need the relevant notice analysis. An internal restriction not communicated where required may not determine the third-party result. Delegation likewise has conditions:an agent cannot simply subcontract every personal undertaking,but the law recognises the specified sub-agent situations. Banking collection agency should be identified transaction by transaction rather than applied to all deposits.

self_check.prompt_text: Does general authority mean authority to perform every possible act?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Scope and applicable legal limits remain.

payload.stem_md: A representative has authority for one defined transaction and signs an unrelated facility for the principal. What must the bank verify?

options.text_md: Only whether the signature is neat
A rule that any representative has universal power
options.explanation_md: Special authority has a defined scope.

options.text_md: The representative personal credit score alone
options.explanation_md: That does not establish agency scope.

options.text_md: The actual authority for the particular act and relevant third-party rules
options.explanation_md: The mandate must cover the transaction or another legal basis must be established.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The mandate must cover the transaction or another legal basis must be established.

payload.stem_md: An agent delegates a task personally undertaken without examining any legal permission or customary exception. Which issue arises?

options.text_md: Whether the applicable delegation or sub-agent conditions are met
options.explanation_md: The task and legal basis must be identified.

options.text_md: All agencies terminate when a third party is contacted
options.explanation_md: Third-party dealing is central to agency.

options.text_md: A higher fee automatically cures missing authority

payload.correct_explanation_md: The task and legal basis must be identified.
